# configuration modification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:configurationModification`](gmeow-configurationModification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/configurationModification>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A modification applied in this configuration — prepared, scordatura, capo, mute, electrified, extended range, etc. Non-functional so that compound modifications (e.g. muted + electrified) can be asserted in one relator.
